test_comparison.estimand_note: Standard protocol: the checkpoint is SELECTED on validation (max macro-F1 over the evaluation points) and the held-out test split is then scored on that same checkpoint, which is verified by re-scoring the restored model on validation (restored_validation_macro_f1 must equal validation_macro_f1_selected_max). So delta_test_minus_validation_matched is a true generalisation gap, not an artefact of comparing different weights. Escape rate stays a validation-only quantity: it is defined over the ten evaluation points, and the test split is measured once.
